articles.title: The Workforce Behind the Roadmap
articles.description: For three years, every semiconductor conference has featured some version of the same slide: the industry doesn’t have enough people to build what it’s promising. This month, SEMI’s National Network for Microelectronics Education (NNME), backed by the National Science Foundation and the U.S. Department of Commerce, named its first Industry Advisory Committee to turn those warnings into a national strategy, against a projected U.S. shortfall of 127,000 to 157,000 workers by 2030. The post The Workforce Behind the Roadmap appeared first on Semiconductor Digest.
